facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: hazard report during shift handover on PSV-7102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-7102 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-7102 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during shift handover while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 17 November 2011 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during shift handover; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
